## Goal

Enforce an all-file live-storage budget, change-only history, bounded retention/checkpoint work, revision-pinned pagination, and streaming exports with visible capacity gaps.

- Storage admission and retention
- Bounded shared queries
- Streaming export
- Stress tests

## Acceptance Criteria

- `AC-304-01` — Unchanged scans do not generate file-count times scan-count history, and database/WAL/log/temp usage reaches controlled behavior under churn.
- `AC-304-02` — UI, export, and MCP share bounded revision-consistent query services and surface coverage, truncation, cursor expiry, and capacity limits.
- `AC-304-03` — Large exports stream without whole-bundle memory growth and completed manual exports remain user-owned.
